items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides support for marking the ApplicationContext associated with a test as dirty for both test classes and test methods annotated with the @DirtiesContext annotation.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 为支持将带有 @DirtiesContext 注解的测试类和测试方法关联的 ApplicationContext 标记为 dirty（脏）提供支持。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that provides support for executing SQL scripts and inlined statements configured via the @Sql annotation.
items.translation: 提供对通过 `@Sql` 注解配置的 SQL scripts 和行内 statements 执行支持的 `TestExecutionListener`。

items.source: Abstract base class for TestExecutionListener implementations that provide support for marking the ApplicationContext associated with a test as dirty for both test classes and test methods annotated with the @DirtiesContext annotation.
items.translation: 用于提供支持的 `` 实现的抽象基类，可将带有 `@DirtiesContext` 注解的测试类和测试方法关联的 `` 标记为 dirty。

items.source: Get a list of newly instantiated TestExecutionListeners for the test class in the BootstrapContext associated with this bootstrapper.
items.translation: 获取此引导程序关联的BootstrapContext中测试类的新实例化TestExecutionListeners列表。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that provides support for executing tests within test-managed transactions by honoring Spring's @Transactional annotation.
items.translation: 提供对在执行测试管理的事务内运行测试的支持的TestExecutionListener，通过尊重 Spring 的@Transactional注解。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides mock Servlet API support to WebApplicationContexts loaded by the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 为通过 Spring TestContext Framework 加载的 WebApplicationContexts 提供模拟 Servlet API 支持。

items.source: Get the current TestExecutionListeners registered for this TestContextManager.
items.translation: 获取当前为这个TestContextManager注册的TestExecutionListeners。

items.source: Register the supplied array of TestExecutionListeners by appending them to the list of listeners used by this TestContextManager.
items.translation: 注册提供的 TestExecutionListeners 数组，将其追加到此 TestContextManager 使用的监听器列表中。

items.source: Register the supplied list of TestExecutionListeners by appending them to the list of listeners used by this TestContextManager.
items.translation: 注册提供的 TestExecutionListeners 列表，将其追加到此 TestContextManager 使用的监听器列表中。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that enables @BeanOverride support in tests, by injecting overridden beans in appropriate fields of the test instance.
items.translation: 支持在测试中注入被覆盖的 Bean 到测试实例的适当字段中的 `TestExecutionListener`，从而启用对 @BeanOverride 的支持。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that resets any mock beans that have been marked with a MockReset.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 会重置所有已标记为MockReset的模拟 Bean。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides support for ApplicationEvents.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 提供对 ApplicationEvents 的支持。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that publishes test execution events to the ApplicationContext for the currently executing test.
items.translation: 发布测试执行事件到当前正在执行的测试的 ApplicationContext 的 TestExecutionListener。

items.source: Get the default TestExecutionListeners for this bootstrapper.
items.translation: 获取此引导程序默认的TestExecutionListeners。

items.source: AotTestExecutionListener is an extension of the TestExecutionListener SPI that allows a listener to optionally provide ahead-of-time (AOT) support.
items.translation: AotTestExecutionListener 是 TestExecutionListener SPI 的扩展，允许监听器可选地提供提前编译（AOT）支持。

items.source: Abstract ordered implementation of the TestExecutionListener API.
items.translation: 抽象的 ordered 实现，针对 TestExecutionListener API。

items.source: JDBC support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework, including support for declarative SQL script execution via @Sql.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的 JDBC 支持类，包括通过 @Sql 声明式执行 SQL 脚本的支持。

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。

items.source: Ahead-of-time (AOT) support for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的提前编译（AOT）支持。

items.source: Test event support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 测试事件支持类，用于Spring 测试上下文框架。

items.source: Support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 支持Spring TestContext Framework的类。

items.source: Transactional support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 用于Spring TestContext Framework的事务支持类。

items.source: Web support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的 Web 支持类。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which makes sure that common caches are cleared once they are no longer required.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 确保在不再需要时清除常用缓存。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides support for dependency injection and initialization of test instances.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 提供对测试实例的依赖注入和初始化支持。

items.source: Support case-by-case Bean overriding in Spring tests.
items.translation: 支持在 Spring 测试中逐案覆盖 Bean。

items.source: Bean overriding mechanism based on Mockito mocking and spying.
items.translation: 基于 Mockito 模拟和间谍的 Bean 覆盖机制。
